title: Configuration values, validation and scope

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

actions:
The real configuration view labels effective values and their default/user provenance. Values0,3601 and fast each produce the integer1–3600 refusal and nothing written. Cancel leaves configuration unchanged.
Saving a status script and interval7 distinguishes saved7 from effective5 and explicitly requires restart. Relaunching the same conversation shows the script running and effective7. Selecting Dark Green Terminal applies its colors live and the view records the selected theme with user provenance.
A repository interval9 overrides the user setting. Attempting a user save of11 is explicitly refused as shadowed; repository save succeeds and labels saved11 versus effective9. The filed written-user-configuration.txt and written-repository-configuration.txt contain the sanitized configuration lines for the two writes; together with the repository scope, refusal, and save frames, they show only the selected repository configuration changed.
An environment override of30 is read-only and names TALARIA_STATUS_INTERVAL_SECONDS with the explanation that file writes would be shadowed. Attempted editing and apply leave it unchanged and report nothing changed — no write.
A deliberately malformed configuration file produces a visible /config refusal saying is not valid TOML and Expected ] at the end of a table declaration. Only its absolute path is masked. The end of the syntax detail is ellipsized at200columns; the refusal and reason are legible.

expected.text: Expose effective configuration and provenance, reject invalid inputs without writes, honor cancel and scope, distinguish restart from live changes, and visibly refuse malformed files.

actual:
All fourteen new frames were visually reviewed. Captures use200columns and closed Inspector with its session fence. Recorded file checks verify cancel and write scope. Previously queued focus concerns are not asserted fixed by these closed-Inspector frames.
